issues.on_page: line 19 Transfers In of Surplus Fees 23,872.00 (p1) vs line 50 Transfers Out Other Than Surplus Fees 23,872.00 (p3)
issues.issue: The form pairs line 19 with line 49 (surplus fees), but the report puts the inflow on line 19 and the outflow on line 50. Amounts tie (p5 schedule: W/S Fund to Water Tower 13,000 + Water System 10,872 = 23,872), both sides are in the Enterprise Fund and are recorded as other financing, so the net is 0. The line mismatch is in the report itself and does not change any figure.
